affected_subject.reason: Identifies _createCampaign() in DistributionCreator and the rewardTokenMinAmount() check.

trigger_or_action.reason: Creating a campaign with reward amount just above minimum so post-fee amount falls below threshold.

direct_effect.reason: Campaign passes validation while actual distributed per-epoch amount is below the minimum.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Explicit invariant: minimum reward-per-epoch must be enforced on post-fee distributed amount, but check uses pre-fee amount.

summary: Report clearly describes the affected function, the trigger (campaign creation with near-threshold amount), the direct effect (underfunded distribution passing validation), and the violated minimum-per-epoch invariant computed on pre-fee instead of post-fee amount.
